title: IFS Analysis
description: Global atmospheric analysis fields from the ECMWF Integrated Forecasting System (IFS), including a subset sourced from the NCAR/UCAR GDEX archive. Coverage spans from January 2016 through May 2026 at global extent, stored in icechunk format across nearly one million files totalling ~33 TB.
